items.name: choicebox
items.title: Choicebox
items.description: A card-styled selection group for single and multi select, built on the Base UI Toggle Group. Horizontal rows or vertical cards, with radio or checkbox indicators. Fully theme-token driven and icon-library agnostic.

items.name: choicebox-radix
items.title: Choicebox (Radix)
items.description: The Radix variant of Choicebox — visually identical to the Base UI variant, built on the Radix Toggle Group (type="single" | "multiple"). Install this when your project's base is `radix`.

items.name: fact
items.title: Fact
items.description: A compact, read-only label→value block for detail and summary surfaces — ids, dates, status, counts. Lay several out in a flex/grid for a facts strip. Fully theme-token driven; the value slot is freeform.

items.name: fact-radix
items.title: Fact (Radix)
items.description: The Radix-base variant of Fact — byte-for-byte identical to the Base UI variant (Fact is a pure display primitive with no interactive library). Install this when your project's base is `radix`.
